title: Winter Fest 2026 Debuts New Winter-Themed Tournament Experience
snippet: More than 70 teams competed across 16 brackets at Central Park as Playmaker Sports introduced Winter Fest-themed trophies, medals, pins, backdrops, and an expanded tournament app experience.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Winter Fest returned to Central Park in Santa Clarita with more than 70 teams competing across 16 brackets. The weekend brought clubs and families together for two full days of youth soccer and a new event experience built around the tournament's winter theme.

Champions and finalists received newly designed Winter Fest trophies and medals, while players could collect tournament pins and take photos at themed backdrops around the venue. Those details were created to give teams something memorable beyond the final whistle.

The Playmaker Sports Tournament App also played a larger role throughout the weekend. Families used it to follow schedules, scores, standings, and tournament updates from one place as competition moved through group play and championship matches.

Thank you to the players, coaches, referees, volunteers, partners, and families who helped make the 2026 event possible. Winter Fest will continue to grow as a competitive and welcoming stop on the Southern California youth soccer calendar.

title: Playmakers Cup Delivers a Milestone Weekend in Moorpark With New Innovations
snippet: The third annual Playmakers Cup welcomed 96 teams for more than 150 matches and marked the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App, including Follow My Team and Follow My Club.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: The third annual Playmakers Cup brought 96 teams to Moorpark for more than 150 matches over Thanksgiving weekend. Arroyo Vista Park again served as the center of a busy two-day tournament filled with close games, championship moments, and families from across the region.

The weekend also marked the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App. Follow My Team and Follow My Club gave players, coaches, and families a faster way to keep up with schedules, results, standings, and the teams that mattered most to them.

New event touches continued off the field, with tournament displays, awards, and on-site experiences designed to make the Playmakers Cup feel like more than a standard weekend of games. The goal was to create a tournament players would remember while keeping information easy to find throughout the event.

Playmaker Sports thanks every participating club, coach, referee, volunteer, partner, and family. Their support helped the Playmakers Cup reach another milestone and set the foundation for the next edition.

title: Playmaker Sports Summer Championship Heats Up Moorpark
snippet: Over 90 teams from across Southern California gathered at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for the Playmaker Sports Summer Championship. Two-time MLS Cup Champion Bryan Jordan joined to hand out medals and sign autographs.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: More than 90 teams from across Southern California arrived at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for the Playmaker Sports Summer Championship. The two-day event delivered a packed schedule of group matches and finals in warm summer conditions.

Two-time MLS Cup champion Bryan Jordan joined the tournament to present medals, meet players, and sign autographs. His visit gave young athletes a chance to celebrate their weekend with someone who competed at the highest level of the American game.

The tournament was built to combine competitive soccer with a welcoming event atmosphere for players and families. Coaches, referees, volunteers, and staff worked across the venue to keep matches moving and make the championship experience memorable.

Playmaker Sports is grateful to every club and family that took part. The Summer Championship continues to grow as a place for teams to test themselves, finish the season together, and celebrate the game.

title: Winter Fest 2025 Recap
snippet: A fantastic weekend of competitive matches across all age groups at Central Park in Santa Clarita.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: Winter Fest brought teams to Central Park in Santa Clarita for a full weekend of competitive youth soccer. Matches across the age groups gave players the chance to compete, develop, and finish the winter season in a tournament setting.

From the opening games through the championship rounds, clubs produced exciting finishes and strong performances. Families filled the sidelines and helped create the energetic, community-focused atmosphere that Playmaker Sports works to bring to every event.

Thank you to the coaches, referees, volunteers, partners, players, and supporters who made Winter Fest 2025 possible. Their work on and off the field kept the weekend running and made it a success for the participating teams.
We look forward to welcoming the soccer community back for future Playmaker Sports tournaments and building on the Winter Fest experience.

title: Playmakers Cup - Moorpark Recap
snippet: 116 teams competed in 195 games over two days at Arroyo Vista Park. LA Galaxy and Salvadoran soccer legend Mauricio Cienfuegos presented trophies and medals to champions and finalists.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: The Playmakers Cup welcomed 116 teams to Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for 195 games over two days. The Thanksgiving weekend event brought together boys' and girls' teams for a wide range of competitive divisions.

LA Galaxy and El Salvador soccer legend Mauricio Cienfuegos joined the celebration to present trophies and medals to champions and finalists. Meeting one of the region's most recognizable soccer figures made the awards ceremonies especially memorable for players and families.
Across the weekend, coaches and players navigated group play, close elimination matches, and championship games while supporters created an energetic atmosphere around the fields.

Playmaker Sports thanks the participating clubs, the City of Moorpark, officials, staff, volunteers, partners, and every family that helped make the tournament possible. The event's growth reflects the support of the Southern California soccer community.

title: Playmakers Cup is Back!
snippet: We're excited to announce the return of our premier Thanksgiving weekend tournament at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark, CA.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: The Playmakers Cup is returning to Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for Thanksgiving weekend. The tournament will bring boys' and girls' teams together for two days of competitive soccer in one of Southern California's leading youth soccer communities.

Teams can expect organized brackets, quality fields, championship awards, and a tournament environment designed for players and families. Playmaker Sports is focused on delivering clear communication before the event and a smooth experience throughout the weekend.

Registration is open to eligible youth teams, with space determined by age group and division. Clubs are encouraged to register early so tournament staff can build balanced brackets and complete scheduling.
Event information, schedules, results, and future updates will be available through Playmaker Sports. We look forward to welcoming returning clubs and first-time participants to Moorpark.

title: Recap of The First Ever Playmakers Cup!
snippet: The inaugural Playmakers Cup brought 62 boys' and girls' teams from across California to Central Park for more than 100 games and crowned champions across 10 divisions.
author: Playmaker Sports
body: The first Playmakers Cup brought 62 boys' and girls' teams from across California to Central Park for more than 100 games. Ten divisions crowned champions during a landmark weekend for Playmaker Sports.

The inaugural tournament was created to give clubs a competitive, well-organized event while making the weekend enjoyable for families. From the first group matches to the final awards, the venue carried the energy of teams building a new tournament tradition together.

Players competed hard across every division, and coaches, referees, volunteers, and staff helped keep a demanding schedule moving. The support from participating clubs made the first edition possible and provided a strong foundation for future events.
Thank you to everyone who joined us for the beginning of the Playmakers Cup. We are excited to keep improving the experience and welcome more of the soccer community in the years ahead.
